notes.title: Content update
notes.content: [p]In Artificial Ignorance, you must lead your AI company to world domination and destroy the world along the way. New achievements, programs, and mechanics. The original game modes remain intact.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 - 6/21/2025
notes.content: [p]Now you can set the game in windowed mode in the options panel (only in the main menu). You can resize the window freely.[/p][p][/p][p]Two new songs added to the music loop.[/p][p][/p][p]Steam achievements bug fix.[/p]
